difficulty_reason: The proof constructs an explicit nonredundant Mackey double-coset system for the wreath subgroup pair, computes the conjugated stabilizer action on tensor factors, and transports the ordinary dominance-ordered Specht filtration through exact functors. Once ordinary Mackey theory and symmetric-group branching are granted, those coupled modular constructions remain substantive obligations beyond standard qualification exercises. The unselected first branching rule and numerical multiplicity specializations add no count.
source_scope_note: Prove exactly the single second wreath-product Specht branching theorem6.1 over an arbitrary field, with every original multipartition/base-Specht indexing and dominance-ordered quotient convention intact. Complete new nonredundant double-coset system, conjugated tensor action and exact-functor filtration proof retained. No first branching theorem4.1 or component/multiplicity variation counted. Classical Mackey theory, ordinary symmetric-group Specht branching (James Theorem9.3), tensor/induction identities and the explicitly cited Young-subgroup tableau double-coset correspondence are ordinary prerequisites. All selected new representatives, stabilizer computation, tensor action and transported filtrations are fully authored here. Two isolated pointers to that example in185/188 are removed by an inventoried finite prose-only adaptation.
